seo.title: Set Easy — Gym & Strength Training App for iOS
seo.description: Set Easy is a focused iOS workout logger for sets, reps, and progressive overload. Keep workout templates, start sessions quickly, and compare progress over time.

hero.label: Strength Tracking
hero.title: Log workouts, track strength, stay consistent.
text: Set Easy is a focused iOS workout logger for sets, reps, and progressive overload. Keep workout templates, start sessions quickly, and compare progress over time.

items.title: Workout-ready sessions
items.text: Start a lifting session fast with clear set entry fields and immediate feedback while you train.

items.title: Exercise templates
items.text: Save routines you use regularly and keep every set plan consistent across sessions.

items.title: Progress visibility
items.text: Review your bests, progression, and volume to keep your program on track over weeks.

items.title: No cloud dependence
items.text: Everything runs locally so your lifts stay private, including your full training history.

items.title: Apple Health support
items.text: Designed for athletes who want local logging with native platform integration when needed.

sections.title: Privacy
text: Set Easy is built for private fitness tracking. Training history stays on-device; we do not require sign-in and do not send your workouts to external analytics.

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Install Set Easy to track smarter and stay focused on what matters.
